generationInputs.prompt: A realistic CD jewel case, cleanly lit with soft reflections and light shadows, is placed squarely in the center of a light gray background, showcasing a minimalist, retro-style vector artwork cover. The album art features simplified graphic forms using flat colors and bold outlines. On the left, a multi-faceted, brilliant-cut peach is stylized with bold shapes and thick outlines, surrounded by a cloud of white smoke or vapor with soft, diffused edges. To the right of the peach, an upright, transparent medical eggplant is depicted with clear numerical markings in black. A small amount of clear liquid is inside the barrel, the plunger is white and extended, and the needle cap is light blue. A bold album title in a wide, rounded typeface is present, along with a fictional label name and logo in one corner. The overall composition is polished and editorial, like a clean, conceptual product photo.
